title: Arion Kurtaj, a 21-year-old Lapsus$ member, pleads guilty in UK court to hacking Rockstar, Uber, BT, and others, after being released from a secure hospital (Joe Tidy/BBC)
summary: Joe Tidy / BBC: Arion Kurtaj, a 21-year-old Lapsus$ member, pleads guilty in UK court to hacking Rockstar, Uber, BT, and others, after being released from a secure hospital — A hacker has pleaded guilty to a string of online crimes, including trying to extort the makers of Grand Theft Auto 6 after stealing dozens of unfinished clips of the game.
